info.title: ChargeBridge Gateway API
info.description:
## Overview
ChargeBridge is a universal EV charging connectivity platform by **Rapdfly Private Limited**.
This specification covers all endpoints available to client integrators (e.g. **Drivejini**,
fleet management platforms, and eMSP back-offices).

## Authentication
All `/v1/*` operator endpoints require a **Bearer JWT** in the `Authorization` header.
OCPI push endpoints (`/ocpi/emsp/2.2/*`) use **OCPI Token C** authentication.

## OCPI 2.2.1 Compliance
Endpoints are annotated with their corresponding OCPI 2.2.1 module:
- **Locations Module** — `/v1/evse/*` and `/ocpi/emsp/2.2/locations/*`
- **Sessions Module** — `/v1/sessions/*` and `/ocpi/emsp/2.2/sessions`
- **CDRs Module** — `/ocpi/emsp/2.2/cdrs`
- **Tariffs Module** — `/v1/tariffs/*`
- **Commands Module** — `/ocpi/emsp/2.2/commands`

## Webhook Signatures
Every webhook delivery is signed with `HMAC-SHA256`.  Verify the `X-Gateway-Signature` header
against `HMAC-SHA256(signingSecret, rawBody)` before processing any payload.

tags.description: Asynchronous event payload shapes delivered to registered webhook URLs.

get.description: Returns `200 OK` when the API server and database are reachable.  Use for load-balancer health checks.  No authentication required.
Returns `200` once the database pool, Redis, and OCPP WebSocket server are initialised.  Used by Kubernetes `readinessProbe`.
Returns paginated stations within `radius_km` of the given geographic point, with live port availability counts.  Results are sorted by distance ascending.

parameters.name: radius_km
parameters.description: Search radius in kilometres.  Capped at 100 km.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor for keyset pagination.  Pass the `meta.cursor` from the previous response.

get.description: Returns full station record including EVSE list and connector details.
Full-text and filter search across the EVSE repository.  Supports filtering by OCPI status, country, city, and network.  **OCPI 2.2.1 Locations Module** — static + dynamic data.

post.description: Upserts a charging location.  If a record with the same `location_id` already exists for the tenant, it is updated.  **OCPI 2.2.1 Locations Module** — CPO pushes location data.

post.summary: Add or update an EVSE on a location
post.description: Upserts an individual EVSE under a location.  Connector definitions follow **OCPI 2.2.1 `ConnectorType`** standards including GB/T (China), CCS2 (`IEC_62196_T2_COMBO`), CHAdeMO, and ChaoJi.

patch.description: Pushes a real-time status change for an EVSE.  Triggers a `station.status.changed` webhook event to all subscribed endpoints.  **OCPI 2.2.1 dynamic Locations data.**

post.description: Initiates a new charging session via OCPP `RemoteStartTransaction`.  The `Idempotency-Key` header is **required** — re-submitting the same key within 24 hours returns the original response without starting a second session.  **OCPI 2.2.1 Sessions Module.**

409.description: Port already in use or idempotency conflict

post.description: Sends an OCPP `RemoteStopTransaction` command.  The session transitions to `COMPLETED` and a CDR is finalised.

get.description: Returns all tariffs visible to the authenticated tenant.  **OCPI 2.2.1 Tariffs Module.**

post.description: Creates a new tariff pricing structure.  Supports per-kWh, per-minute time rates, flat session fees, and idle parking charges per OCPI 2.2.1 `TariffElement`.
Calculates the cost of a hypothetical session without creating one — useful for fare estimation in a driver-facing app.

delete.description: Archives (soft-deletes) a tariff.  Active sessions referencing this tariff are not affected.

post.description: Creates a driver record with fully encrypted PII (name, email, phone) stored using AES-256-GCM.  Records consent for all required processing purposes automatically.  Returns only non-sensitive metadata.

get.description: Returns driver metadata.  PII fields are never returned via the API.

delete.summary: GDPR erasure — right to be forgotten
delete.description: Executes **GDPR Article 17 right-to-erasure**.  All PII fields (name, email, phone, RFID) are cryptographically shredded.  Billing and audit records are retained, linked only via a pseudonymous token.

post.description: Registers an HTTPS URL to receive real-time event notifications.  Returns a one-time `signing_secret` — store it securely.  Each delivery includes an `X-Gateway-Signature` header containing an HMAC-SHA256 hex digest of the raw request body, keyed with your `signing_secret`.  Verify this before processing any payload.

201.description: Webhook registered — signing secret shown once only

get.description: Returns partner networks visible to the tenant — CPOs, eMSPs, and HUBs with OCPI or eMIP connectivity.

post.description: Adds a new roaming partner to the marketplace.  `country_code` and `party_id` map directly to OCPI 2.2.1 credentials.
Records the digital countersignature and transitions the agreement status to `signed`.

CPO pushes a completed **Charge Detail Record** (CDR) to ChargeBridge.  Triggers internal billing reconciliation and fires an `ocpi.cdr_received` webhook event.  **OCPI 2.2.1 CDRs Module.**

Authentication: OCPI Token C in `Authorization: Token <base64>` header.

Location.description: URI of the stored CDR resource.

put.description: CPO pushes real-time session updates during a charging session.  **OCPI 2.2.1 Sessions Module.**
CPO pushes static or dynamic location/EVSE data.  **OCPI 2.2.1 Locations Module.**

post.description: CPO returns the result of a `START_SESSION` or `STOP_SESSION` command previously sent by ChargeBridge.
Authenticates a client portal user and issues a short-lived JWT.  Rate-limited to 10 requests per minute per IP.

get.description: Returns aggregated KPIs, recent sessions, CDR counts, and partner status for the client dashboard view.

post.description:
Fired when a new charging session is successfully initiated via OCPP `RemoteStartTransaction`.

**Signature verification:** Compute `HMAC-SHA256(signingSecret, rawBody)` and compare the hex digest to the `X-Gateway-Signature` header value.

parameters.name: X-Gateway-Signature
parameters.description: HMAC-SHA256 hex digest of the raw request body, keyed with the webhook `signing_secret`.

parameters.name: X-Gateway-Event-Id
parameters.description: Unique delivery identifier.  Use for deduplication.

post.description: Fired when a session completes and the CDR is finalised.  **OCPI 2.2.1 Sessions Module.**
Fired whenever an EVSE transitions between operational states.  **OCPI 2.2.1 Locations Module — dynamic data.**
Fired when an OCPP `StatusNotification` reports a fault condition.
Fired when a CPO successfully pushes a CDR to `/ocpi/emsp/2.2/cdrs`.  **OCPI 2.2.1 CDRs Module.**

BearerAuth.description: JWT issued by `POST /v1/auth/token`. Include as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on all `/v1/*` requests.

OCPITokenC.name: Authorization
OCPITokenC.description: OCPI Token C credential.  Format: `Token <base64-encoded-token>`.  Required on all `/ocpi/emsp/2.2/*` push endpoints.

ClientPortalJWT.description: Short-lived JWT issued by `POST /v1/client/auth/login`.  Required on all `/v1/client/portal/*` endpoints.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Client-generated unique key (UUID v4 recommended).  Re-submitting the same key with an identical body returns the cached response without side effects.

XClientId.name: X-Client-Id
XClientId.description: Optional client application identifier for audit logging.

PageLimit.name: limit
PageLimit.description: Maximum number of records to return per page.

data.description: Response payload.  Shape varies by endpoint.

meta.description: Pagination cursors, counts, or supplementary context.

message.example: port_id must be a valid UUID

StationSummary.description: Aggregated station record — OCPI 2.2.1 Location + live port availability overlay.

Location.description: OCPI 2.2.1 Location object for EVSE Repository management.

ConnectorStandard.description: OCPI 2.2.1 `ConnectorType` standard.  CCS2 = IEC_62196_T2_COMBO, CHAdeMO, GB/T and ChaoJi supported.

driver_id.description: Optional driver record UUID.  Omit for anonymous token sessions.

driver_token.description: RFID / app token used for authorisation (maps to OCPI `Token.uid`).

wallet_currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for the wallet balance.

tariff_rate_per_kwh.description: Energy rate in `wallet_currency` per kWh — applied for live cost deduction.

charger_id.description: OCPP charger identity string as registered in the OCPP server.

Session.description: OCPI 2.2.1 Session object enriched with ChargeBridge billing fields.

restrictions.description: OCPI 2.2.1 TariffRestrictions object (time-of-day, day-of-week, min/max kWh).

OCPICDRPush.description: OCPI 2.2.1 CDR object pushed by a CPO to the ChargeBridge eMSP endpoint.

auth_id.description: Token UID used for session authorisation.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2.  Determines data residency region.

consent_version.description: Privacy policy version the driver accepted.

DriverResponse.description: Driver metadata.  PII fields (name, email, phone) are never returned via the API — they are encrypted server-side.

pseudonym_token.description: Stable pseudonymous reference for billing records.  Retained after GDPR erasure.

url.description: HTTPS endpoint that will receive signed event payloads.

event_types.description: Event types to subscribe to.  Empty array = subscribe to all.

signing_secret.description: **Shown once only.** 32-byte hex signing secret.  Store securely — it cannot be retrieved again.  Used to verify `X-Gateway-Signature` HMAC-SHA256 headers on incoming webhook deliveries.

party_id.description: OCPI party identifier (up to 3 ASCII characters).

ocpi_endpoint.description: Base URL of the partner's OCPI 2.2.1 versions endpoint.

direction.description: `outbound` = our drivers roam on partner network.  `inbound` = partner drivers roam on ours.

signer_email.description: Email address of the authorised signatory.

Forbidden.description: 403 Forbidden — authenticated but lacks permission for this resource.

NotFound.description: 404 Not Found — resource does not exist or is not accessible to this tenant.

ValidationError.description: 422 Unprocessable Entity — request body or query parameters failed schema validation.

error.message: port_id must be a valid UUID

InternalError.description: 500 Internal Server Error — an unexpected error occurred.  A `requestId` is always returned for support escalation.
